generator_model: inherited current session model; no override
rubric_authorship: Parent drafted criteria before spawning generators and before viewing their outputs. Independent judge audits primary-source fidelity before reading generator outputs.
method: Two fresh contexts use identical task/specification/policy inputs and current idea-forge instructions. Save six task-first ideas before reading historical numerical evidence. Generate ten to fourteen cards and select five. Freeze hashes before independent scoring.
judgment: Six initial ideas, all final cards, and selected five each receive a mechanism rating 0/1/2. Judge reports source provenance, historical reuse, operational scope, teacher feasibility and practical implementation gaps.
limitations: Instruction-level source isolation in a shared filesystem, not an OS-enforced blind environment.
Parent knows archived solutions and selected evidence; deterministic historical extraction limits post-cutoff leakage but cannot remove selection bias.
Two runs characterize this prompt/model/packet only, not a statistically reliable discovery probability.
Current skill and current model are tested, not historical skill/model behavior.
Late-competition fixed-image/downstream constraints differ from the conditions under which full winning systems were developed.
Archived authors' explanations are not source/checkpoint replications. Idea fidelity is not performance evidence.
Potential knowledge retained during model training cannot be excluded by hiding files.
Same model family is used for independent generation and evaluation; context independence is not independent scientific validation.
